Main file: five in-scope routes - corn (grain) ethanol fermenter_biomass_grain (candidate fermenter_grain-dry-mill), lignocellulosic ethanol fermenter_biomass_lignocellulosic (fermenter_lignocellulosic-enzymatic), FAME biodiesel transesterification-unit_liquid-biomass (transesterification-unit_alkali-catalyzed; rapeseed and palm are cases of one example), BTL gasifier_biomass_fischer-tropsch (gasifier_fischer-tropsch) and HVO reactor_liquid-biomass_hydrotreating (reactor_hydrotreating-lipids). Processes: Table 4 summary (plant size, lifetime 25 yr from merged cells, advanced-fuel conversion efficiency 12-35%, advanced-plant capex 1.7-2.5 2010 USD per l/yr, biomass input derived from the 110-300 / 75-200 l/t yields); Table 1 (co-product flows DDGS, lignin, glycerine - three commodities requested); Table 2 (commercial and large commercial advanced plants: capacity, capacity factor derived from hr/yr, biomass input derived); text (water 4-8 l/l cellulosic ethanol). Service unit m3 of biofuel (the archetypes use t; no density is given). Sidecars (not loaded): _out-of-scope-routes (sugarcane, sugar beet, soy, algae), _life-cycle (Table 1/4 yields per ha, CO2 reduction, energy balances), _prices (Table 3 and Table 4 retail prices, cost structures, projections), _advanced-plant-scales (Table 2 all scales), _context.
